assessment: This study by Li et al. presents important findings on the metabolism-independent role of nuclear IDH1 in chromatin regulation during erythropoiesis. The authors provide convincing evidence that IDH1 deficiency disrupts H3K79 methylation and nuclear architecture, contributing to dyserythropoiesis. Their findings offer invaluable mechanistic insights with potential therapeutic implications for erythroid disorders and hematologic malignancies.
